activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

autopost_bills.help: Automatically post bills for this trusted partner

barcode.help: Use a barcode to identify this contact.

calendar_last_notif_ack.string: Last notification marked as read from base Calendar

country_code.help:
The ISO country code in two chars. 
You can use this field for quick search.

country_enforce_cities.help: Check this box to ensure every address created in that country has a 'City' chosen in the list of the country's cities.

credit.help: Total amount this customer owes you.

credit_limit.help: Credit limit specific to this partner.

days_sales_outstanding.help: [(Total Receivable/Total Revenue) * number of days since the first invoice] for this customer

debit.help: Total amount you have to pay to this vendor.

email_normalized.help: This field is used to search on email address as the primary email field can contain more than strictly an email address.

employee.help: Check this box if this contact is an Employee.

group_rfq.help:
Define if RFQ should be grouped         together based on expected arrival, except for dropship operations.
         On Order: Replenishment needs will be grouped together except for MTO.
         Daily: Replenishment needs will be grouped if the expected arrival is the same day
         Weekly: Replenishment needs will be grouped if the expected arrival is the same week or week day
         Always: Replenishment needs will always be grouped.

has_vat.help: Technical field indicating whether the Tax ID is not a placeholder.Returns False for placeholder values such as '/', 'NA', 'na', or an empty string.

incoterm_id.help: International Commercial Terms are a series of predefined commercial terms used in international transactions.

is_blacklisted.help: If the email address is on the blacklist, the contact won't receive mass mailing anymore, from any list

is_company.help: Check if the contact is a company, otherwise it is a person

lang.help: All the emails and documents sent to this contact will be translated in this language.

main_user_id.help: There can be several users related to the same partner. When a single user is needed, this field attempts to find the most appropriate one.

message_bounce.help: Counter of the number of bounced emails for this contact

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

on_time_rate.help: Over the past x days; the number of products received on time divided by the number of ordered products.x is either the System Parameter purchase_stock.on_time_delivery_days or the default 365

partner_share.help: Either customer (not a user), either shared user. Indicated the current partner is a customer without access or with a limited access created for sharing data.

phone_blacklisted.help: Indicates if a blacklisted sanitized phone number is a phone number. Helps distinguish which number is blacklisted             when there is both a mobile and phone field in a model.

phone_sanitized.help: Field used to store sanitized phone number. Helps speeding up searches and comparisons.

phone_sanitized_blacklisted.help: If the sanitized phone number is on the blacklist, the contact won't receive mass mailing sms anymore, from any list

property_account_position_id.help: The fiscal position determines the taxes/accounts used for this contact.

property_product_pricelist.help: Used for sales to the current partner

property_purchase_currency_id.help: This currency will be used for purchases from the current partner

property_stock_customer.help: The stock location used as destination when sending goods to this contact.

property_stock_supplier.help: The stock location used as source when receiving goods from this contact.

purchase_incoterm_id.help: International Commercial Terms are a series of predefined commercial terms used in international transactions.

receipt_reminder_email.help: Automatically send a confirmation email to the vendor X days before the expected receipt date, asking him to confirm the exact date.

reminder_date_before_receipt.help: Number of days to send reminder email before the promised receipt date

trust.string: Degree of trust you have in this debtor

tz.help:
When printing documents and exporting/importing data, time values are computed according to this timezone.
If the timezone is not set, UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) is used.
Anywhere else, time values are computed according to the time offset of your web client.

use_partner_credit_limit.help: Set a value greater than 0.0 to activate a credit limit check

user_id.help: The internal user in charge of this contact.

vat.help: You can use '/' to indicate that the customer has no Tax ID.
